reason: A DSH WebUI plugin providing browser-based host terminal sessions and workspace file browsing; human review is appropriate because it can execute commands, read files, and control processes on the host.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中提供可交互的本机终端模拟器、多会话管理和工作区文件浏览功能。
summaries.en: Provides an interactive local terminal emulator with multi-session management and workspace file browsing in the DSH WebUI.

capabilities: Starts real host PTY sessions using the user’s shell
Accepts and sends arbitrary terminal input to host processes
Reads workspace directory listings and text file contents
Resizes, signals, and terminates terminal sessions
Provides a browser-based terminal and file manager interface
